Theme

Latin word

societās

societās, societātis f.

noun, third declension

a company, a partnership; society, fellowship, partnership

In this lexicon

  • company

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Sest. 32: nūlla Rōmae societās vectīgālium (Lewis & Short); M-O s.v. corporation, company; Traupman 333

  • social

    also used · classical · Cic. Off. 1.54: prīma societās in ipsō conjugiō est; Cic. Amic. 20: societās generis hūmānī (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • numquam est fidēlis cum potente societās

    a partnership with the powerful is never to be trustedPhaedr. 1.5.1

    In the entry for company

  • Parva est societās nostra; decem tantum sumus.

    Ours is a small company; there are only ten of us.composed

    In the entry for company
